title: Chapter 265
text:
The energy core was still the 'Bonfire' reactor, located about five centimeters below his neck. After his advancement, his Machinery Affinity and technology had both increased, so he strengthened the reactor. Furthermore, he installed a few hidden grooves on the back of the mechanical suit that connected to the energy core. Energy blocks could be embedded in the grooves. If the reactor ran out of energy, these would be backup energy sources. There was another use, which was to increase the power output and increase the performance of the combat suit like overload.

The energy blocks were naturally the [Elementary Energy Crystals] that he had refined from the radiation crystals he had collected from the Shadow Stalker Viper's nest. Yi Yeqing was trying to turn the crystals into a renewable resource, but she had not succeeded yet. However, the few hundred pounds of crystals that Han Xiao had saved up were enough.

The armor was a new alloy that he had synthesized from [Advanced Materials]. It was called 'Allie Steel Alloy', and its defense was even higher than platinum alloy. The control method was the new [Nerves Link]. The helmet was equipped with a module that could read the signals of the neurons. It was embedded in the helmet like a metal patch, and the various functions of the mechanical suit could be controlled with just a thought. The weapon module had undergone a technical innovation, and Han Xiao had put in the most effort.

The new module that he paid the most attention to was a large mounted component that was five to six meters long when extended horizontally!

This was a mounted mechanical wing that was embedded in the back, shoulders, and arms. The original version was the Cloud Swallow Glider. The wing was wide, and there was a circular three-stack propeller with a radius of sixty to seventy centimeters on each side. It was a rotary turbine engine that could rotate 360 degrees!

The electromagnetic hover-boots could run up, and the small maneuvering device could take off, glide, and provide continuous power.

He had given the new generation of the combat suit the ability to fly!

Which man did not want to fly freely? The romance of a man was like a corpse sinking into the sea, or a sea of stars!

Successful. You have successfully improved [Lightweight Mechanical Suit – Viper]. Do you want to give a new name?

With a flash of inspiration, a suitable name appeared in Han Xiao's mind.

Naming successful. You have received the blueprint [Lightweight Mechanical Suit – Amphiptere]!

"My naming skills are indeed not for show."

Han Xiao was very satisfied. Amphiptere was a snake that could fly.

I can go to heaven!"With a full set of purple modules, the attributes of Soaring Serpent had reached 2.0. Han Xiao put his hands on his hips and admired his work. He was so f * cking awesome."With Soaring Serpent and my attributes, no one in the Blue Star can threaten me. This mechanical suit can be used in the galaxy. It can be considered as one of my early preparations."Han Xiao had foresight. In the eyes of the players, he had made a super powerful early stage equipment. Wearing this mechanical suit was like using a sledgehammer to crack a nut on a novice planet.Soaring Serpent had only locked onto his nerve signals, and he was the only one who could control it.The advanced knowledge [Nerve Connection] was the foundation to control more complex machinery. The speed of thinking was far faster than normal control methods. Furthermore, if there were any injuries, [Nerve Connection] could also be used on the Cloak technology. Of course, Han Xiao did not wish for such a day to come.Furthermore, [Nerve Connection] had another key function in his eyes. One had to know that players relied on the virtual gaming cabin to enter Galaxy, and the core principle of the gaming cabin was to transfer the players' thoughts.Then, what would happen if the players' thoughts were transferred to a local NPC clone body?Would the players be trapped in Galaxy like him?Would they be resurrected after death?If they could be resurrected, would they use the original player body or a new body?Or … could there be other phenomena?From his perspective, he could feel that everything here was real. However, he had never let go of his doubts and kept paying attention to the forum. He wanted to see if his account in his previous life had appeared, but he did not find anything."What is the reason for this? Is it the butterfly effect? Did the previous' me 'change my account?Hmm, it's not unreasonable. I just casually created the account back then … or is there another possibility? "Han Xiao's eyes flickered. To be honest, he was looking forward to interacting with his previous' self 'face to face. It would definitely be a novel feeling.He did not understand."If I want to understand the truth, I still have to start from the players. [Nerve Connection] alone is not enough to create a gaming cabin or a mind transfer device. I need more knowledge."Han Xiao suppressed the doubts in his heart. Note: "Are you stupid? I can go to heaven!"

With a full set of purple modules, the attributes of Soaring Serpent had reached 2.0. Han Xiao put his hands on his hips and admired his work. He was so f * cking awesome.

"With Soaring Serpent and my attributes, no one in the Blue Star can threaten me. This mechanical suit can be used in the galaxy. It can be considered as one of my early preparations." Han Xiao had foresight. In the eyes of the players, he had made a super powerful early stage equipment. Wearing this mechanical suit was like using a sledgehammer to crack a nut on a novice planet.

Soaring Serpent had only locked onto his nerve signals, and he was the only one who could control it.

The advanced knowledge [Nerve Connection] was the foundation to control more complex machinery. The speed of thinking was far faster than normal control methods. Furthermore, if there were any injuries, [Nerve Connection] could also be used on the Cloak technology. Of course, Han Xiao did not wish for such a day to come.

Furthermore, [Nerve Connection] had another key function in his eyes. One had to know that players relied on the virtual gaming cabin to enter Galaxy, and the core principle of the gaming cabin was to transfer the players' thoughts.

Then, what would happen if the players' thoughts were transferred to a local NPC clone body?

Would the players be trapped in Galaxy like him? Would they be resurrected after death? If they could be resurrected, would they use the original player body or a new body? Or … could there be other phenomena?

From his perspective, he could feel that everything here was real. However, he had never let go of his doubts and kept paying attention to the forum. He wanted to see if his account in his previous life had appeared, but he did not find anything.

"What is the reason for this? Is it the butterfly effect? Did the previous' me 'change my account? Hmm, it's not unreasonable. I just casually created the account back then … or is there another possibility? " Han Xiao's eyes flickered. To be honest, he was looking forward to interacting with his previous' self 'face to face. It would definitely be a novel feeling.

He did not understand.

"If I want to understand the truth, I still have to start from the players. [Nerve Connection] alone is not enough to create a gaming cabin or a mind transfer device. I need more knowledge."

Han Xiao suppressed the doubts in his heart.
